_about: Public-domain Leighton Parks, rector of Emmanuel Church, Boston, and St Bartholomew's, New York, for the Word Hoard: His Star in the East, The Winning of the Soul, Moral Leadership, The Crisis of the Churches, What is Modernism?, an address for the American Colonization Society, and his memoir Turnpikes and Dirt Roads. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 125 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted. He lived past 1930, so only books printed before 1930 are taken.
